title: LosslessCut: Free Tool to Trim Video Without Losing Quality
description:
LosslessCut is a free, open-source tool that trims video and audio files without re-encoding, preserving original quality. Perfect for cutting commercials, extracting music, or merging clips. Fast and easy to use.
